scope: Finite synchronous ownership/preupdate/session/backup API slice; no threads, faults, corruption, extensions or native application fallback.

preupdate.setup: CREATE TABLE changes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,n INTEGER,t TEXT,b BLOB)
actions: UPDATE changes SET n=33,t='three',b=x'ff00' WHERE id=1
preupdate.read: SELECT id,n,t,b FROM changes ORDER BY id

setup: CREATE TABLE item(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,n INTEGER,t TEXT,b BLOB)
actions: UPDATE item SET n=11,t='updated',b=x'ff00' WHERE id=1
session.read: SELECT id,n,t,b FROM item ORDER BY id

limits: Synchronous callbacks only; no arbitrary foreign threads
Destructor coverage is custom bound BLOB reset/rebind/clear/finalize lifecycle
Session apply uses one table and an initial no-conflict pass followed by a bounded repeat with OMIT
In-memory backup only; no concurrent source writes or fault injection
Remaining T4 APIs and broader provider/ownership/error matrices remain open
